sourcedFrom: Ruger PC Charger Instruction Manual — PM817 (2022)
cleanIntro: The PC Charger separates barrel/forend from action without tools beyond a hex wrench — Ruger designed it for transport, and it is how you get at everything for cleaning.

steps.title: Clear it completely
steps.action: Point it in a safe direction, remove the magazine, lock the bolt back and confirm the chamber is empty by sight and by finger.
steps.prose: Magazine, then chamber, before any takedown.
steps.quote: easy takedown for quick separation of the barrel/forend assembly from the action
steps.cite: Ruger PC Charger Instruction Manual — PM817 — Takedown, p.18
steps.warn: Always unload a firearm before cleaning, lubrication, disassembly, or assembly.

steps.title: Loosen — do not remove — the forward takedown screw
steps.action: With a 5/32 inch hex wrench, loosen the forward takedown screw from the chassis. Do not remove it.
steps.prose: Captive by design. Backing it out entirely just risks losing it.
steps.quote: Use a 5/32" hex wrench to loosen (do not remove) the forward takedown screw from the chassis.
steps.cite: Ruger PC Charger Instruction Manual — PM817 — Takedown, p.18

steps.title: Receiver assembly up and off
steps.action: Lift the receiver assembly upward and away from the chassis.
steps.prose: Straight up once the screw is slack.
steps.quote: Lift the receiver assembly upward and away from the chassis.
steps.cite: Ruger PC Charger Instruction Manual — PM817 — Takedown, p.18

deepAbsentReason: PM817 documents the takedown separation for cleaning and transport. No disassembly past it is published, so this listing has NO deep clean.

cleaning.name: BORE & CHAMBER
tasks: Solvent patch from the chamber end, correctly sized brush, then dry patches until clean
Clean the chamber and feed ramp

cleaning.name: BOLT & RECEIVER
tasks: Wipe the bolt face and extractor
Clean the receiver interior and the bolt raceways

cleaning.name: CHASSIS
tasks: Wipe the chassis and magazine well
Check the takedown screw threads for grit before reassembly

reassembly: Seat the receiver assembly back onto the chassis and hand tighten the forward takedown screw with a 5/32" hex wrench.
fncheck: With the magazine out and chamber confirmed empty, confirm the takedown screw is snug and the bolt cycles freely.
